candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this clinical trial is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of paxalisib in combination with temozolomide

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients for the minimal residual disease (mrd) cohort will be eligible following completion of optimal surgery and Stupp based adjuvant chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: 5G-PEARL: Paxalisib in Combination With Temozolomide in Patients With High Grade Malignant Brain Tumours Within the 5G Platform
These patients will be treated with paxalisib in combination with temozolomide (TMZ).

source_quote.quote: Hyperactivating PI3K pathogenic mutations in either PIK3CA (p100) or PIK3R1 (p85) as defined by COSMIC.
PTEN loss as defined by 'two hits' (including either biallelic loss of PTEN, or PTEN LOH + loss of function mutation)
In the Phase 1b of this study parallel biomarker defined arms will be opened, initially in the front-line unmethylated MGMT setting setting, enrolling 10 patients onto each arm.

coder_notes: GBM-only as currently eligible; other CNS tumours only after a future amendment. The PI3K-mutation and PTEN-loss biomarker arms are described in text, not registered arm labels, so arms is empty for them.
